title: What Artificial Retina Implants Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Artificial retinas restore vision: electrode arrays stimulating surviving retinal cells, or photodiode films replacing photoreceptors — turning light into neural signals for the blind. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Artificial Retina Implants: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.

Why it matters: Millions are blind from retinal disease; implants can return functional vision..
Where it is used: retinitis pigmentosa, macular degeneration..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
